<?php
$o = new class {
    public function __isset(string $name): bool {
        echo "I:", $name, ";";
        return $name === "yes";
    }
};
$name = "no";
echo empty($o->{$name}) ? "EMPTY;" : "BAD;";
$name = "yes";
echo empty($o->{$name}) ? "EMPTY;" : "BAD;";

<?php
$o = new class {
    public function __isset(string $name): bool {
        echo "I:", $name, ";";
        return $name === "yes";
    }
    public function __get($name) { echo "GET:", $name, ";"; return 7; }
};
$no = "no";
$yes = "yes";
echo empty($o->{$no}) ? "EMPTY;" : "BAD;";
echo empty($o->{$yes}) ? "BAD;" : "NONEMPTY;";
